# cycle_networks (Data Source)

Lists all Cycle SDN networks in the hub.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List every SDN network in the hub.
data "cycle_networks" "all" {}

output "network_names" {
  value = [for n in data.cycle_networks.all.networks : n.name]
}

output "live_network_ids" {
  value = [
    for n in data.cycle_networks.all.networks : n.id
    if n.state == "live"
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `networks` (Attributes List) All SDN networks in the hub. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--networks))

<a id="nestedatt--networks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `networks`

Read-Only:

- `acl` (String) The network ACL as a normalized JSON object, or null when unset.
- `cluster` (String) The identifier of the cluster whose environments may join this network.
- `environment_ids` (Set of String) Environment IDs currently attached to this network.
- `hub_id` (String) The ID of the hub this network belongs to.
- `id` (String) The unique ID of the SDN network.
- `identifier` (String) The network identifier used to construct HTTP calls that specifically use this network.
- `name` (String) The user-defined name of the network.
- `state` (String) The current state of the network.
